title: 欠阻尼放电：衰减系数与振荡角频率
statement: 图示电路中电容原已充电，v_C(0₋) = 8 V；R = 2 Ω，L = 0.5 H，C = 0.1 F。t = 0 时开关 S 闭合。
求衰减系数 α 和阻尼振荡角频率 ω_d，以及 t = π/8 s 时的电流 i、t = π/4 s 时的 v_C。

questions.explain: ω₀² = 1/(LC) = 20；ω_d = √(ω₀² − α²) = √(20 − 4) = 4 rad/s。√20 ≈ 4.47 是无阻尼振荡角频率 ω₀，不是 ω_d。

questions.ask: t = π/8 s（≈ 0.3927 s）时 i = ?（参考方向见图）

questions.explain: v_C(t) = 8e^(−2t)(cos 4t + 0.5 sin 4t) V。t = π/4：cos π = −1，sin π = 0，v_C = −8e^(−π/2) ≈ −1.663 V——电容被反向充电，这正是振荡的表现。

questions.ask: 放电电流 i 第一次过零（改变方向）是在什么时刻？
choiceExplain: π/8 s 是 ω_d t = π/2，即 sin ω_d t 达到最大的时刻，此时电流仍为正，还没有过零。
1/α 是临界阻尼时电流达到最大的时刻，与欠阻尼电流的过零点无关；欠阻尼时过零由 sin ω_d t 决定。
电流不改变方向只在过阻尼或临界阻尼时成立；这里 R = 2 Ω < 2√(L/C) ≈ 4.47 Ω，是欠阻尼，电流振荡反向。
questions.explain: i ∝ e^(−αt) sin ω_d t，第一次为零在 ω_d t = π，即 t = π/4 s。此时 i = −C·dv_C/dt = 0，v_C 正好达到反向极值（就是前面求的 v_C(π/4)）。

hints: α = R/(2L)，ω₀ = 1/√(LC)，ω_d = √(ω₀² − α²)；特征根 s = −α ± jω_d。
通解 v_C = e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t)，由 v_C(0₊) = 8 V、dv_C/dt(0₊) = −i(0₊)/C = 0 确定 A₁、A₂。
solution: **4. i(t)。** i = −C·dv_C/dt。dv_C/dt = 8e^(−2t)[−2cos 4t − sin 4t − 4sin 4t + 2cos 4t] = −40e^(−2t) sin 4t，i = 0.1 × 40e^(−2t) sin 4t = 4e^(−2t) sin 4t A（与公式 V₀/(ω_d L) = 4 一致）。

en.title: Underdamped discharge: damping coefficient and damped frequency
statement: The capacitor is initially charged, v_C(0−) = 8 V; R = 2 Ω, L = 0.5 H, C = 0.1 F. Switch S closes at t = 0.
Find the damping coefficient α and the damped angular frequency ω_d, the current i at t = π/8 s, and v_C at t = π/4 s.

questions.explain: ω₀² = 1/(LC) = 20; ω_d = √(ω₀² − α²) = √(20 − 4) = 4 rad/s. √20 ≈ 4.47 is the undamped frequency ω₀, not ω_d.

questions.ask: i at t = π/8 s (≈ 0.3927 s) = ? (reference direction as drawn)

questions.explain: v_C(t) = 8e^(−2t)(cos 4t + 0.5 sin 4t) V. At t = π/4, cos π = −1 and sin π = 0, so v_C = −8e^(−π/2) ≈ −1.663 V — the capacitor has been charged the other way round, which is the oscillation at work.

questions.ask: When does the discharge current i first cross zero (reverse direction)?
choiceExplain: π/8 s is where ω_d t = π/2, i.e. where sin ω_d t peaks; the current is still positive there and has not crossed zero yet.
1/α is the peak-current time of the critically damped case; it has nothing to do with the zero crossing of an underdamped current, which is set by sin ω_d t.
A current that never reverses belongs to the overdamped or critically damped case; here R = 2 Ω < 2√(L/C) ≈ 4.47 Ω, so it is underdamped and the current oscillates.
questions.explain: i ∝ e^(−αt) sin ω_d t first vanishes at ω_d t = π, i.e. t = π/4 s. There i = −C·dv_C/dt = 0, so v_C is at its negative extreme (the v_C(π/4) found above).

hints: Classify first: 2√(L/C) = 2√5 ≈ 4.47 Ω > R, so the circuit is underdamped.
α = R/(2L), ω₀ = 1/√(LC), ω_d = √(ω₀² − α²); the characteristic roots are s = −α ± jω_d.
The general solution is v_C = e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t); find A₁, A₂ from v_C(0+) = 8 V and dv_C/dt(0+) = −i(0+)/C = 0.
solution: **2. Parameters.** α = R/(2L) = **2 s⁻¹**, ω₀² = 1/(LC) = 20 (rad/s)², ω_d = √(20 − 4) = **4 rad/s**; roots s = −2 ± j4.
**4. i(t).** i = −C·dv_C/dt. dv_C/dt = 8e^(−2t)[−2cos 4t − sin 4t − 4sin 4t + 2cos 4t] = −40e^(−2t) sin 4t, so i = 0.1 × 40e^(−2t) sin 4t = 4e^(−2t) sin 4t A (matching the formula V₀/(ω_d L) = 4).
**5. Values.** At t = π/8: **i = 4e^(−π/4) ≈ 1.824 A**; at t = π/4: **v_C = −8e^(−π/2) ≈ −1.663 V**. The current first crosses zero at t = π/4 s; the damped period is T_d = 2π/ω_d = π/2 s.
